description_full: Noble Corporation plc operates as an offshore drilling contractor for the oil and gas industry worldwide. It provides contract drilling services through its fleet of mobile offshore drilling units. The company also operates drilling rigs, such as floaters and jackups. It serves its fleets in Africa, the Far East Asia, the North Sea, the Oceania, South America, and the United States Gulf of America. Noble Corporation plc was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.

CEO compensation is 4× revenue per employee (modest relative to workforce productivity). Governance score flags low compensation governance risk (1/10).
financial_summary: Noble Corporation plc A is a mid-cap energy business with a $7.0B market cap on $3.3B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +32% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 8% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.

The business throws off $432M in free cash flow — roughly 13 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 4.39× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, debt is moderate at 3.6× net debt/EBITDA, serviceable in normal conditions but worth watching through a downturn, and thin 2.6× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Shareholder yield of 4.9% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 21% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
